scripts._comment_game: build-game-data regenerates the answer pool and the guess index from the local master_catalog.json. Run it deliberately, look at the printed band report, commit both outputs.
scripts._comment_regen: Rebuild ONE game's published day without running the cron: npm run regen -- flickgrid [YYYY-MM-DD]. It PUBLISHES to R2; add --dry-run to write the files under regen/ and print the upload commands instead. A script rather than a documented command line because the flags are shell-sensitive -- the resolver path is an ARGUMENT, and a shell that takes it for a command hands the .mjs to Windows to open with an app.
